A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. Search for headword: 'dhanush' 3 results Highlight text and press "t" to transliterate (devanagari script only) 1) دهانشك dhānushk
                        ( p. 539 ) S دهانشك धानुष्क dhānushk (fr. dhanus ), s.m. A bowman, an archer ( = dhānuk , q.v.). 2) دهانشکا dhānushkā
                        ( p. 539 ) S دهانشکا धानुष्का dhānushkā , s.f. The plant Achyranthes aspera . 3) دهنش dhanush
                        ( p. 548 ) S دهنش धनुष् dhanush (for dhanus , q.v.; but used in Hindī both in comp. and alone), s.m. A bow; rainbow, &c. ( = dhanuk ): — dhanush-pāṇī (or pānī ), adj. & s.m. Armed with a bow; — an archer: — dhanush-paṭ , s.m. The tree Buchanania latifolia : — dhanush toṛnā , To fire off a bow: — dhanush-ṭaṅkār , s.m. Twang of a bow; — a severe spasmodic affection: — dhanush ṭūṭnā , A bow to go off: — dhanush-dhār = dhanuk-dhar , q.v.s.v. dhanuk : — dhanush-dhārā = dhanuk-dharā , q.v.: — dhanush-dhārī , s.m. = dhanur-dhārī , q.v.s.v. dhanus : — dhanush-dhar , adj. & s.m. = dhanur-dhar , q.v.s.v. dhanus : — dhanush-kshetr , s.m. Segment of a circle: — dhanush-koṭi , s.f. Point or end of a bow: — dhanush-mān , dhanush-mant , adj. & s.m. (f. matī ), Having a bow; — an archer, bowman: — dhanush-vāṇ , vulg. dhanush-bān , s.m. Bow and arrow: — dhanush-vān , adj. & s.m. = dhanush-mān , q.v.: — dhanush-vidyā , s.m. The science of archery: — dhanush-yajna , s.m. Any religious ceremony in which the bow figures as an emblem.
